title: The Year Everything Was About to Change
narrative: Disney+ detonated the streaming wars. Google Stadia promised console-free gaming. Foldable phones hinted at the future. 5G networks began rolling out. TikTok's algorithm rewired how social media works. Zoom went public, unknowingly preparing for a world that would need it. The platforms were ready. The world wasn't ready for what came next.
